HowItWorks.title: From raw file to on-chain commitment
HowItWorks.subtitle: Three steps, three minutes, one hash per data period.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Metrics are canonicalized into deterministic bytes, hashed with keccak256 into a Merkle root.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: The IssuerAdmin signs commitBatch with a CDP embedded wallet. The platform pays gas; UCYield servers never hold the private key.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: The UCYield verifier recomputes the root from the source data. On a match it writes markVerified on-chain with a signed receipt.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.a1: Not yet. Phase 1 runs only on Base Sepolia (testnet). Mainnet comes only after the legal readiness gate is passed.
FAQ.q2: Do you custody funds or keys?
FAQ.a2: No. Phase 1 takes no investor money, and UCYield servers never hold private keys. Issuers sign with their own CDP embedded wallet.
FAQ.a3: Off-chain, AES-GCM encrypted. On-chain holds only hash, Merkle root and metadata.
FAQ.a4: After a commit, the UCYield verifier recomputes the root from the source data under the same hashing spec. On a match it writes markVerified to ShadowLedgerV3 with the hash of a signed receipt. In Phase 1 the checker is UCYield itself; there is no Chainlink DON or TEE yet. Those are Phase 2.
FAQ.a5: Issuer teams: upload data, sign commits, browse commitment history.
FAQ.a6: Download the record's evidence bundle, recompute the root with the hashing spec in the docs (or the ucy-verify CLI), and compare it with the recordRoot stored on ShadowLedgerV3. You do not need to trust UCYield servers for this step.

Connect.title: Two ways in. The same checked record.
Connect.subtitle: Huawei FusionSolar data can come in through the plant owner’s approval or through a technical API account. Either way it is reviewed, anchored on Base and verified.
Connect.ownerSub: Sign in with Huawei · no password shared with UCYield
Connect.apiTitle: The team uses an API account
Connect.apiSub: Technical account from the plant’s Huawei system
Connect.owner1: The issuer team adds a data source, picks Huawei FusionSolar and clicks “Connect Huawei with OAuth”. A Huawei window opens.
Connect.owner2: On Huawei’s own page the plant owner signs in and clicks Allow. UCYield never sees the owner’s password.
Connect.owner3: Back in UCYield: choose the plant and a closed month, check the sample, then click “Save & fetch data”.
Connect.owner4: The fetched data waits for review. A reviewer checks the numbers and clicks “Anchor on Base”, signing with the issuer’s wallet.
Connect.owner5: The record goes Anchoring, then Anchored on Base, then Verified on Base. Only a fingerprint goes on-chain.
Connect.api1: The issuer team adds a data source, picks Huawei FusionSolar, types the API account’s username and password, and clicks “Check account”.
Connect.api2: UCYield lists the plants this account can see. The team ticks a plant and a closed month.
Connect.api3: The team checks the sample data, then clicks “Save & fetch data”. UCYield fetches the month from Huawei.
Connect.api4: The fetched data waits for review. A reviewer checks the numbers and clicks “Anchor on Base”, signing with the issuer’s wallet.
Connect.api5: The record goes Anchoring, then Anchored on Base, then Verified on Base. Only a fingerprint goes on-chain.
